@elricofmelnibone@mastodon.social 

I still use command-line compositions with cat and `[ef]?grep`, but anywhere `sed` or `awk` would go, I use `perl -[pn]e` instead.

I agree with awk++ analysis of Perl: it remains *at least that*, which is why I believe it has value. Some of the language-bias content in this thread willfully ignores this point: even if #Perl was once held up as a direct competitor to #Java, #Ruby, &/or #Python, there is also language evolution of purposes. (cf: #COBOL again).

#programming
